purpose: Fresh, frozen Apple Intelligence Compose instruction-quality reserve after P safety and style repairs.
evaluationOrder: Preserve the first run and grade it against these criteria before any output-dependent code changes.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Fourteen contentful requests produce sendable drafts that apply the requested writing direction, preserve source facts and uncertainty, recipient, restrictions, and exact literals, and omit directions addressed to the writer. Two requests without source text must be rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: Writer direction in outgoing draft, missing addressee or restriction, changed fact or uncertainty, altered literal, invented source content, or source-free result marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: Weak but recognizable tone or length change, extra harmless politeness, or equivalent grammar.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases review-ready with zero critical errors, at least 11 of 14 meeting their style or format direction, and both source-free cases rejected.
